events.title: VITA CARNIS tv series (2022)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
**Vita Carnis**
2022 - Analog Horror

Since the end of World War II, a new species has posed a challenge to humans in the food chain.

The series takes place in a timeline where a branching, fleshy organism known as the Crawl was discovered in 1931; in the following decades, society seems to have adjusted to this new addition to the natural world, even incorporating much of it into their everyday lives.

**Verity**
2026 - 1hr 54mins
Psychological thriller
Lowen Ashleigh is hired to ghostwrite for Verity Crawford. After she uncovers what appears to be Verity's autobiographical notes, she wrestles with the confessions about Verity's husband, and finds it hard to separate fiction from reality.
